Commentary.Commentary: West Indies were seen crippling at the end but thanks to a cameo from Rovman Powell, they have managed to cross the 200-run mark. Mohammed Shami was the pick of the bowlers as he ended with figures of 10-0-48-4. Umesh Yadav also supported him really well as he clinched three wickets of his own. The spin duo of Ravindra Jadeja and Kuldeep Yadav kept the scoring rate in check and they were unlucky to go wicketless. The Windies will look to recreate the magic they did in the last game to pull off a victory here. Can the hosts level the series or will the tourists chase it down easily? Join us in a while to find that out.

Another inspirational bowling performance from India has restricted the hosts to a below-par total. The top order gave the home side a good start but the scoring rate kept on dipping as Kyle Hope departed. Shai Hope though managed to stick it out but he hardly got any support until Jason Holder stepped out in the middle. They both stitched in a vital 48-run stand but the latter lost his wicket in search of quick runs. However Shai Hope could not kick on after scoring a fifty.
Williams makes room but is outfoxed by Yadav, who bowls it wide outside off. WEST INDIES END ON 205/9!

Banged in short, angling in. It's too good for the last man, who gets a top edge and the ball falls safely between him and Dhoni. Even Jadeja from backward point sprints to the ball but collects it on the bounce.
Kesrick Williams is the last man in.

OUT! 3-fer for Umesh Yadav! The fumble actually works in India's favour. The pacer bowls is short and down the leg side. Powell looks to pull it on its way but gets a glove to Dhoni, who takes a regulation catch. West Indies have collapsed once again. Not the performance they would have hoped for in the series decider.
Back of a length delivery, Powell mistimes his heave to deep mid-wicket. Rahane in the deep fumbles and concedes an extra run. Two runs taken. Will this fumble prove costly?
Powell stays leg sidish. Umesh spots that and cleverly pitches it wide outside off. The batsmen can't do anything about it.
SIX! In the arc! Fuller length delivery outside off, Powell kneels down and slogs it straight down over long on for another biggie. Good start to the over for WI. They cross the 200-run mark.
Back of a length delivery, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single. Shami finishes with the figures of 10-0-48-4!
Shami replies superbly with a sharp bouncer. Powell looks to hook it away but misses. He looks sideways to the umpire, who signals nothing.
SIX! Into the stands! Slower delivery outside off, Powell clubs it over long on for a maximum. For the first time he connects it well and gets the deserved result.
Shortish delivery, Powell looks to pull it across but misses it completely.
Shortish delivery, angling down leg, nudged to fine leg for a single.
Slower one around off, Alzarri fails to pick it and is beaten.
Back of a length delivery outside off, rises sharply onto the batsman. Joseph glides it off the outer half to third man for a single.
Back of a length delivery, angling in. Powell looks to pull it but gets a top edge which falls short of the deep mid-wicket fielder. A single is taken.
Short and angling in, tucked towards square leg for a single.
Full outside off, Joseph goes for the drive but is beaten.
Almost a yorker, dug out to long on for a single.
Wide! The ball slips off Yadav's hand and lands wide outside off. The umpire signals it a wide.

Full and angling in, Powell goes for the heave. Gets a thick inside edge to it and the ball goes through the backward square leg region. The fielder there makes a good stop and the batsmen run a couple.
Alzarri Joseph will bat next for West Indies.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Back of a length delivery, angling away. Bishoo bends backwards and looks to guide it past the keeper but gets a faint nick to Dhoni, who pouches it with ease. Shami is having a gala time out there.
Back of a length delivery around off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Bishoo swings hard, gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball deflects on the off side and a single is taken.

FOUR! Streaky! Slower delivery on the fuller length. Bishoo looks to drive it on the off side but gets an outside edge and the ball takes an outside edge past the keeper. The third man fielder fails to cut it off and WI pick an valuable boundary.
Banged in short, DB ducks under it in time.
Slower one outside off, placed to covers for a single.
Change of ends for Mohammed Shami! He starts his run-up but halts mid way as he realizes that there is one fielder less inside the 30-yard circle.
Angling away from the southpaw, who makes room and looks to bunt it over on the off side but misses. Maiden from Umesh Yadav!
Short again, Bishoo looks to pull it but mistimes it back to the bowler.
Short delivery, Bishoo tries to ramp it over but misses.
Superb stop by Jadeja! Full outside off, Bishoo makes room and carves it behind point. Jadeja there, dives to his right and makes an excellent stop.
Pitched around off, pushed to covers.
Angling away from Bishoo, who looks to cut but misses.
Umesh Yadav is back on.
The batsman defends it from within the crease. For the first time in the series, Kuldeep has gone wicketless in the match.
Wrong one around off, dabbed with spin to backward point.
Full outside off, Bishoo drives it straight back. Kuldeep is too casual and lets it go. A single is taken.

DROPPED! And that too by Dhoni! Served around off, spinning away sharply with extra bounce. Bishoo looks to punch it on the off side but gets an outside edge. It goes straight in the gloves of Dhoni, who fails to hold onto it. Now, that's a rarity. The ball then lobs just ahead of Dhawan at first slip, who is guilty of not being alert and flat-footed. A reprieve for Bishoo.
Powell prods forward and places it behind square on the leg side for a single.
On the pads, flicked on the leg side for a couple.

OUT! Soft dismissal! 3-fer for Shami! Very full on middle and off, Nurse looks to dig it out on the leg side but ends up chipping it to Kuldeep Yadav at short mid-wicket. Shami has pulled things back for India in a great fashion. Nurse his latest scalp, gets out on a nought.
Banged in short outside off, Nurse gets on his toes to glide it on the off side but misses.
Pitched outside off, tapped on the off side for a quick single.
Googly around off, Nurse opens the face of the bat and dabs it behind square on the off side.
Served around middle and leg, spinning down. Nurse leans ahead to defend but misses and gets rapped on the pads. A muted appeal is turned down.
Powell goes back and punches it to deep cover for a single.
Served around leg, Powell once again fails to pick it. The ball brushes the thigh pad and rolls on the leg side.
Full around off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
Beaten! Kuldeep bowls a wrong 'un outside off and Powell once again fails to pick it. Is beaten on his push again.
Full on the stumps, driven crisply to long on for a single.
Banged in short, RP ducks under it.
Ashley Nurse is the new man in.

The ball skies high in the air and is in the air for a long time. Rahane at deep square leg, looks to get under it, misjudges a bit in the start but keeps his eyes on the ball. Has to dive in the end to complete a scorching catch. The hosts are losing the plot here. The well-set Shai departs.
Banged in short around off. This takes Hope by surprise, who ducks underneath it.
Length delivery around off, Rovman looks to heave it away but mistimes it through square leg for a single.
Full on middle and off, lofted over mid on for a single.
Full on middle and off, clipped to mid-wicket.

Another googly around off, glided past the slip fielder for a brace.

Full toss around off, Shai Hope punches it towards mid on and calls for a quick single. The fielder there has a shy at the non-striker's end but he fails to hit. A single is taken easily at the end.

OUT! Holder departs! Short delivery outside off, Jason Holder stays in his crease and tries to make the most of it. Flat bats it towards the long on region. Dhawan the fielder there goes to his left and takes a good running catch to dismiss the dangerous Holder. A wrong time to lose a wicket.
Full and angling into the stumps, Holder clips it towards square leg. Calls for a single but is sent back. Kuldeep Yadav has a shy at the striker's end but he fails to hit.
FOUR! Holder is getting on a move on here! Fuller around off, Holder backs away on the leg side. Smashes it over the cover region for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery outside off, dabbed through the backward point region. Dinesh Karthik goes to his right from third man and makes a fine stop. Saves two runs for his team.
Good length delivery outside off, defended towards point by Holder.

The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Holder drives it towards long off for a single.
Holder prods forward and defends it.
Deep point comes in place.
FOUR! Reverse swept to perfection! Fuller around off, Holder fancies the reverse sweep again. Makes contact perfectly as he gets it through the point region for a boundary.
A bit quicker into the pads, Holder fails to clip it through this time. Gets rapped high on his pads.
Sprayed into the pads, Holder fails to clip it through. Gets rapped on the pads.
Good length delivery outside off, Holder glides it towards third man for a single.

Fifty! Angling into the batsman, clipped through the mid-wicket region for a single. Hope has been brilliant and WI will need to keep him going in such a manner.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Holder drives it through mid off for a single.
SIX! Brilliant... What a hit! Length delivery outside off, Holder shuffles across and smashes it over the mid-wicket region. He picked the cutter early, there.
Short delivery and the bouncer is still climbing, Holder goes for the hook but he fails to make contact.

A rare thing happens as the Indian all-rounder fails to grab the ball cleanly as he comes steaming in to it. The batsmen run a single easily.
FOUR! Brilliant! Full toss around off, Holder goes for the reverse sweep again. Gets it through the backward point region for a boundary.

Bowls it around middle and off, Hope clips it through mid on for a single.

Spinning in from middle, clipped to mid-wicket.
Full on middle and off, defended down the track.

Sliding into the batsman, worked through mid-wicket. The fielder there misfields and concedes a single. Kohli is frustrated with his man there.
Full outside off, pushed on the off side.
Slightly quicker, slanting in, punched back to the bowler.

NOT OUT! Low full toss, Jason drives it crisply through extra cover. Umesh at long off, covers good ground to his left, dives to make a wonderful stop and then gets back in a flash to hurl a throw at the striker's end. The two batsmen hesitate in the middle and Mohammed has to back track and dive in to come back. The throw is a good one and Dhoni takes the bails off in a flash. The umpire goes upstairs and the replay shows that Mohammed has made it in just in time.
The umpire have gone upstairs to check for a run out appeal against Jason Mohammed. Seems pretty close.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. One run added to the total.

Floated around off, clipped to mid-wicket.

Sharp turn! Served full outside off, spins away sharply. Mohammed looks to defend with a straight bat but gets beaten. The ball brushes Dhoni's gloves and rolls behind. But, no extra taken.
Full around off, pushed with soft hands to mid off. Seeing the fielder there slightly deep, JM takes off for a quick single and completes it with ease at the end as the shy at his end misses.
Played to the point region by the batsman.

Shout for lbw! Kuldeep goes flatter this time. Pitches it around leg and the gets the ball to straighten. Mohammed goes back and looks to work it across the line but misses and gets rapped on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire turns it down. Missing leg maybe!

Driven towards long on for a single.

Jason Mohammed pushes it towards the cover region for a single.
Fuller outside off, defended on the off side.
Tossed up in the line of the stumps, Jason Mohammed gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Floated outside off, pushed through covers where the fielder misfields and the batsmen run a single.
Jason Mohammed is the new man in.

OUT! Two-in-two! Roston Chase departs on a golden duck! Bowls it right on the money, on a very fuller length on middle. Chase cannot get his bat down in time and the ball sneaks through to rap him on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire is quick to raise his dreaded finger. Chase consults Shai Hope and opts for the review. Replays show that there was no bat involved. Ball Tracker also shows that it was pitched in line, impact was in line and was also going on to hit the stumps. West Indies have lost their review and India have got a major breakthrough. Another disappointing performance from Roston Chase. Yadav will be on a hat-trick on the first ball of his next over.
Chase has been ruled out LBW. However, he has opted for the review. Looks out to the naked eye.
Roston Chase is the new man in.

Time for Drinks! Just when it looked like West Indies were cruising, India have managed to pull things back just in time. It will be again a rebuilding phase for the hosts as they have just lost Kyle Hope. Can India make further inroads or will West Indies prove their resilience?

OUT! Kyle throws it away in his attempt to take the bowler on! Back of a length delivery outside off, Kyle goes for the pull. Does not get the height on it as the ball rockets straight towards Dhawan at mid-wicket. He takes a good, sharp catch and an important partnership between the Hope brothers comes to an end.
Length delivery around middle and leg, Kyle clips it towards the fielder at mid on.
FOUR! Two in a row! Umesh bangs in short this time, Kyle Hope stays in his crease and pulls it over the mid-wicket region for a boundary. There is no stopping that.
FOUR! Brutal! Length delivery outside off, Kyle slams it powerfully down the ground. Beats the mid off fielder and the ball races away to the fence.

Fuller around middle and leg, Kyle clips it towards long on for a single.

Shai Hope reached into the double figures for 16th straight ODI innings from debut. Only Mark Taylor(17) and Michael Bevan(19) have a better record than him.

FOUR! Top shot! Fuller in line of the stumps, Shai sweeps and sweeps beautifully through the backward square leg region for a boundary.
Tossed outside off, spinning away, Shai gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Ravindra Jadeja is called in for a bowl.
Back of a length delivery around off, Kyle defends it towards mid on off the back foot.
Wide! Sprayed down the leg side, Kyle still goes for it but fails to make contact.
Fuller delivery outside off, Kyle drives it towards the fielder at mid off.
Another short delivery around off, Shai runs it down towards third man for a single.

Another delivery on a shorter length outside off, Kyle shuffles across and defends it on the leg side and scampers across for a quick single.

Good length delivery outside off, Shai gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.

Wide! Tries a bouncer again but this time misses his line completely. Sprays it way down the leg side and Shai is happy to let it through. A wide is signaled. It can either be for height or for the bounce.

Length delivery outside off, Shai lets it through to the keeper.

FOUR! Good shot! Fuller outside off, Shai Hope leans into the delivery and drives it beautifully through the cover region for a boundary.

Back of a length delivery outside off, dabbed towards the fielder at point.

Length delivery, angling down leg, played with the angle to Jadhav in front of square on the leg side.
On a length outside off, Kyle chops it to backward point.
Back of a length delivery, Hope again shimmies a touch and defends it to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Full and drifting down leg, Kyle Hope shuffles across and times his flick superbly. Gets it through backward square leg region to the fence. This is poor bowling from Yadav, seeing Hope timing his flick superbly before.
Full again, Kyle shimmies across and pushes it to mid on.
Full on middle and off, angling in, flicked crisply but straight to Jadhav at mid-wicket.
Back of a length around off, Hope gets on his toes and defends it on the leg side.
Back of a length delivery into the batsman, Hope clips it towards fine leg for a single.

FOUR! A brilliant delivery and an even better shot! Full and nipping into the stumps, Kyle Hope nearly falls over as he shuffles across. Still manages to clip it beautifully through the square leg region for a boundary.
Good length delivery outside off, nipping back in. Kyle Hope covers his stumps and lets it through.
Comes around the wicket this time, Shami angles this one into the pads. Lewis flicks it towards fine leg. A single is taken.
Angling in from a good length outside off, Kyle Hope shuffles across and clips it towards the fine leg region for another single.
Back of a length delivery into the batsman, Lewis pulls it towards fine leg for a single.
Full and angling in, pushed to mid on.
Fullish delivery, clipped to mid-wicket.
Slanting into the pads, Hope flicks it behind square leg for a brace.
FOUR! Another one! Short outside off, Kyle punches it through covers. The fielder in the ring gives it a chase but fails to pull it back. Good start to the over for WI.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Slapped away! Short and wide outside off, Hope stays tall and cuts it through point for a boundary. Change of ends not working for Umesh.
Umesh Yadav is back for a bowl. Change of ends for him as well.
Fullish delivery, defended down the track.

NOT OUT! Hope stays in the crease, defends it wide of mid on and takes off for a quick single. Kuldeep from mid on, gets to the ball and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. The players appeal and the umpire goes upstairs. The replay shows that Kyle had made it in with ease.
The umpire has gone upstairs to check for a run out appeal against Kyle Hope.
Hope was cut in halves! A touch ahead of a length around off, nips in sharply after pitching. Kyle looks to push it down the ground but gets beaten by the movement off the seam. That was very close!
Short and down the leg side. Evin pulls it to fine leg for a single.
Again on a length on middle, bounces a touch extra. Lewis covers the line of the ball and blocks it.
Length delivery on middle, defended neatly.
Change of ends for Mohammed Shami.
Fuller again around off, Hope gets across and drives it off the inner half to mid on.
Pitched around off, nips back in a touch. Hope makes a watchful leave.
Fullish delivery, pushed to mid on.

Good shot from Lewis! He goes back and punches it crisply. Finds the gap between point and covers but the ball doesn't get to the fence due to a slightly slower outfield. Three runs added to the total.
Back of a length delivery, angling away, punched solidly to mid off.
Full around off, driven to mid off.
Hardik Pandya is introduced early into the attack.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Shortish delivery outside off, Kyle rides the bounce and taps it to point.
Wide! Short and wide outside off, swinging away further. Hope leaves it and a wide is signalled.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Short and wide outside off. Hope latches onto that width and slaps it behind backward point. The third man cuts it off with a dive. Saves a couple of runs for his team.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Shortish delivery, angling down leg. Lewis shimmies a touch and tickles it fine past the keeper and to the fine leg fence. First boundary of the innings.
Lewis dabs it in the point region for a quick single.
Umesh Yadav to bowl from the other end with the second new ball. Two slips in place.
Again it's back of a length, around leg this time. Lewis camps back to pull but doesn't get a clean connection. The ball goes to fine leg and a single is taken.
Back of a length delivery, angling away, Evin goes back and punches it to mid off.
Lewis stays in the crease and defends it to mid on.

Back of a length delivery, angling in. Hope stands tall and with soft hands dabs it on the leg side and takes off for a quick single. Jadhav is a bit slow to the ball and his shy at the striker's end doesn't hit. Had he hit, it would have been a close one. A single is completed.
Again on a length, angling in, defended on the leg side.
Leg bye! Pitches it on a length around middle and leg, nips back in. Lewis looks to work it across the line but misses. The ball rolls off the thigh pad on the leg side and a leg bye is taken.

The players have made their way out in the middle. Evin Lewis and Kyle Hope to open for the hosts. Mohammed Shami to start the proceedings with the first new ball. He has a couple of slips in place and will bowl from over the wicket. Here we go...

Virat Kohli says that he is going with the same team for the last match. Reckons that it is not a bad thing to bat second here. Mentions that he has not played much ODI cricket on this ground. Adds that they will look to correct the things which went wrong in the last game. Informs that he wants to contribute in each every game but he also needs to accept that it is not possible. Ends by saying that even if he cannot contribute, he hopes that the other guys can step up and seal the deal for them.

Jason Holder says that they are going to bat first. Mentions that it looks like a good track and they will look to put some runs on board. Adds that they defended well in the previous game and hopefully they will do it again. Believes that the batsmen haven't been doing well but it's another day and another opportunity to do well. Ends by saying that they are playing the same team and everyone is rejuvenated after the last game.
TOSS - West Indies win the toss and opt to bat.

PITCH REPORT - Jeff Dujon inspecting the pitch says that the grass is rolled in nicely. It disappears through the length and the deck becomes firm. There are a few cracks as well but it might not open up. The ball is going to come onto the bat nicely. There's something for everyone, spinners will get some turn and pacers will get extra bounce. Ends by saying that it is a great pitch for the series decider.

The hosts on the other hand were brilliant in the 4th ODI as they finally managed to compete and also emerge victorious. Jason Holder will want his boys to recreate such a performance in order to draw the series level. Hope rain does not play spoilsport as a cracker of a game awaits.

Hello and a warm welcome to the fifth and the final ODI between India and West Indies in Kingston. After taking an unassailable 2-0 lead, the visitors lost their plot in the previous game where they suffered an uncharacteristic defeat. They would look to change that and get back to winning ways as a win is a must for them to seal the deal.
